propositions: Two capability decisions are made via provider-name string matching (startswith, hardcoded frozensets) rather than reading model.profile, causing Bedrock-hosted Claude to silently lose native output and prompt caching because the model string says 'bedrock' not 'anthropic'

capabilities_for() must accept either a model object with .profile or a lazy provider-qualified model string, reading profiles cleanly without importing vendor SDKs (pydantic_ai.profiles.* are capability-only, unlike pydantic_ai.providers.*)

A rebar override table must force native_structured_output=False for Claude on both direct-API and Bedrock hosts because anthropic_model_profile(...).supports_json_schema_output is True but PromptedOutput is the deliberate, tested path
Field-presence detection (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching attribute check) must replace isinstance(BedrockModelProfile) to avoid importing boto3 in CI where it is absent under [agents] extra

cache_settings_for(caps: ModelCapabilities) replaces _anthropic_cache_settings(resolved: str), dispatching cache key selection on caps.prompt_cache_style (anthropic/bedrock/none) instead of string prefix matching

supports_thinking field on ModelCapabilities is load-bearing for S5 signed provenance but is NOT consumed by output_mode() — output_mode() keeps reading the caller-supplied thinking argument because thinking+native-output is a documented Anthropic 400 error
